globalThis.comparison=(()=>{
  const v=globalThis.variant??0,result={};
  document.body.style.cssText='margin:0;width:800px;height:600px';
  const target=document.createElement('div');target.id='target';document.body.appendChild(target);
  const sheet=document.createElement('style');document.head.appendChild(sheet);
  const width=condition=>{sheet.textContent='div{width:10px}@supports '+condition+'{div{width:'+(30+v)+'px}}';return target.getBoundingClientRect().width;};
  result.trueRule=width('(width: 1px)')===30+v;
  result.falseRule=width('(width: potato)')===10;
  result.not=width('not (width: potato)')===30+v;
  result.and=width('(width: 1px) and (display: flex)')===30+v;
  result.andFalse=width('(width: 1px) and (future-property: 1px)')===10;
  result.or=width('(future-property: 1px) or (width: 1px)')===30+v;
  result.parentheses=width('((width: 1px) and ((display: flex)))')===30+v;
  result.nestedNot=width('(not (width: potato)) and (width: 1px)')===30+v;
  result.general=width('future(hello)')===10;
  result.generalNot=width('not (future hello)')===30+v;
  result.importantRule=width('(width: 1px !important)')===30+v;
  result.case=width('(WIDTH: 1PX) AND (DISPLAY: FLEX)')===30+v;
  result.comments=width('(width/**/:/**/1px)/**/and/**/(display:flex)')===30+v;
  sheet.textContent='@layer a,b;@layer b{@supports(width:1px){div{width:40px}}}@layer a{div{width:20px}}';result.layers=target.getBoundingClientRect().width===40;
  sheet.textContent='@media(min-width:1000px){@supports(width:1px){div{width:45px}}}';result.media=target.getBoundingClientRect().width===45;
  result.one=CSS.supports('(width:1px)');result.implicit=CSS.supports('width:1px');result.two=CSS.supports('WIDTH','1px');
  result.invalid=!CSS.supports('width','potato')&&!CSS.supports('unknown','1px');
  result.propertyWhitespace=!CSS.supports(' width','1px');
  result.importantValue=!CSS.supports('width','1px!important')&&CSS.supports('(width:1px!important)');
  result.custom=CSS.supports('--box','any tokens')&&!CSS.supports('--empty','');
  result.customInvalid=!CSS.supports('--','value')&&!CSS.supports('--box','value; width:1px');
  result.mixed=!CSS.supports('(width:1px) and (height:1px) or (display:flex)');
  result.unwrappedNot=!CSS.supports('not width:1px');
  result.missingTerm=!CSS.supports('(width:1px) and');
  result.generalQuery=!CSS.supports('future(hello)')&&CSS.supports('not future(hello)');
  let conversions=0;result.coercion=CSS.supports({toString(){conversions++;return 'width';}},{toString(){conversions++;return '1px';}})&&conversions===2;
  let missing=false,symbol=false;try{CSS.supports();}catch(error){missing=error.name==='TypeError';}try{CSS.supports(Symbol());}catch(error){symbol=error.name==='TypeError';}result.arguments=missing&&symbol;
  result.detached=CSS.supports.call(null,'width','1px');
  result.namespace=Object.getPrototypeOf(CSS)===Object.prototype&&Object.prototype.toString.call(CSS)==='[object CSS]'&&CSS.supports.length===1;
  const snapshot=target.getBoundingClientRect();sheet.textContent='@supports(width:1px){div{width:50px}}';result.snapshot=snapshot.width===45&&target.getBoundingClientRect().width===50;
  return result;
})();
